Author: Sunita Agarwal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 29
Case :- Writ - C No. - 1659 of 2023
Petitioner :- Jaipal Singh
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Amul Kumar Tyagi,Santosh Kumar Shukla

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Mahesh Narain Singh,Ravi Prakash Pandey Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.

The petitioner herein has approached this Court, at the stage when the limits of the public road has been earmarked by Ghaziabad Development Authority for removal of encroachment thereon by private person.
The petitioner herein submits that he has raised construction over the plot in question after the same has been declared as non agricultural land by the revenue authority vide order dated 25.06.2021.
The submission is that all shops which are facing threat of demolition have been constructed by the petitioner over the land belonging to him in Gata no.838 which is minzumla number.

In none of the paragraphs of the writ petition, the petitioner has disclosed as to whether he has sought permission of the Ghaziabad Development Authority for construction of the shops in question after the declaration of the land in question as non agricultural by the order dated 25.06.2021.

Moreover, Sri M.N Singh learned counsel for the respondent submits that the petitioner Jaipal Singh vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165637357/
1 has encroached by the construction made on the public land and the shops have been constructed over the public road and hence demarcation has been made for demolition of the unauthorised construction.

sentences.text: No map has been sanctioned by the development authority for the construction in dispute.

In the said scenario, the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 is wholly misconceived.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The writ petition is, dismissed as misconceived.
The dismissal of this writ petition, however, will not come in the way of the petitioners to challenge the demolition proceedings by taking recourse to the appropriate legal remedy.
